text:
Rohit: Kicking off marketplace onboarding for NimbusTrial across AWS/GCP/Azure. We need owners for images, offer metadata, legal copy, pricing, and a staging window.
Kayla: I'll own the manifest + pricing. Proposal: 14-day trial, per-seat metered.
Diego: Infra needs exact artifact locations: AMI id, GCE image name, Azure VHD path. Also a tiny TF outputs file with `publisher_account_id`, `listing_bucket`, `kms_key_arn`, and `delegated_admin`.
PartnerOps: Staging publisher folder `marketplace-nimbus-staging` created in 1Password. Uploaded creds and placeholders: aws_account, gcp_project, azure_tenant.
Maya: Legal: draft EULA (redlines ok), short DPA clause, export-control statement, and telemetry blurb (default 30 days, aggregated, opt-out). Will post drafts.
Rohit: Assets we need: SVG + 1200x600 PNG, three screenshots, short blurb <=240 chars, long blurb <=1200 chars, demo link, docs URL, marketing contact. Regions US/EU/APAC by default.
Diego: For GCP please provide a `gcloud compute images create` command or image tarball. For Azure include a minimal ARM template snippet.
PartnerOps: Uploaded initial images: AMI `ami-0f2a3b4c`, GCP image `nimbus-stg-2026-10-12`, Azure VHD `nimbus-stg.vhd` and checksums to the vault. Posted links.
Kayla: I'll draft a manifest skeleton and put it in `marketplace/manifests/nimbus.json`. Snippet: {"offerId":"<tbd>","sku":"nimbus-trial","pricing":{"trial_days":14,"model":"per_seat"},"recommended_instance":"g5.xlarge"} 
Maya: Telemetry clause to iterate: "Aggregated non-PII usage retained 30 days; customers may opt out; no PII transmitted." Adding that to the EULA draft.
Diego: Action items: 1) PartnerOps - confirm final offerId and publisher display name by EOD. 2) Diego - post TF outputs + ARM/GCP snippets by EOD. 3) Maya - upload EULA + DPA drafts by Thu. 4) Kayla - publish manifest draft and update after infra/legal inputs.
OnboardBot: Preflight job queued: nimbus-preflight-2887654321 scheduled 2026-10-20 09:00 UTC.
Rohit: Thanks all 12 I'll schedule a 30m dry-run on the calendar for Mon 09:00 PT. Ping @Rohit if blocked.
